paragraphs: Ashyan bar Nadbakh, related by marriage to Rav Yeiva; Bava Batra 22b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב״ב כב:. is rendered Bava Batra 22b. The William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic there calls Yeiva the father-in-law of Ashyan bar Nadbakh; it does not establish a children-married relationship.
Hyman’s own מחותנו is retained as “related by marriage,” without silently replacing it with the named passage’s narrower wording. Both source units and Hyman’s full Rav title for Yeiva are preserved.
